# Which EU Batteries Regulation duties reach your battery, and by when?

> Free EU Batteries Regulation (2023/1542) checker for makers, importers and online sellers: which duties reach your battery, when each applies (label, removability, QR code, battery passport, due diligence), and what is still open. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
